title: KLA Academy
address:
1109 SW 4th Ave
Miami, Florida 33130
United States
description:
KLA Academy is a five-story, 131,000-square-foot private campus in the heart of Brickell, serving students from infancy through 5th grade. The school follows a Reggio Emilia-inspired urban model built for roughly 450 students, with indoor and outdoor playgrounds, a rooftop basketball court, and a full-scale 230-seat performing arts theater.

Other spaces include a fifth-floor rooftop sports complex with a multi-purpose hard court and a turf soccer field, an art atelier, a soundproofed music studio, and a dining hall with a vertical garden and learning kitchen, plus a covered outdoor preschool playground.
